speaker: Doctor
text:

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CT Chest and Abdomen/Pelvis: Multiple enlarged mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes noted. Splenomegaly confirmed with increased organ size. Multiple new subcutaneous and retroperitoneal lymphadenopathies identified. No focal pulmonary masses, pleural effusion, or ascites observed.

speaker: Doctor
text: The CT findings of mediastinal and hilar lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly, and retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy are highly suggestive of a lymphoproliferative disorder. Have you noticed any skin rashes, specifically "B" symptoms like night sweats or fevers, and is there any history of autoimmune conditions like lupus or rheumatoid arthritis? speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Has a history of diabetes mellitus type II, hypertension, non-seminomatous testicular cancer treated in the past, and hypercholesterolemia. Social history: Currently smokes 1 pack of cigarettes per day and drinks a glass of wine daily. Denies any illicit drug use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
